study_identification_part.si4_title: Beyond homogeneity: charting the landscape of heterogeneity in neurodevelopmental and psychiatric electroencephalography

cm1_research_objectives.reason: The paper clearly states its objectives: (1) apply normative modeling to high-density EEG to quantify individual-level heterogeneity in spectral power and functional connectivity across ADHD, ASD, ANX, and LD cohorts versus matched controls; (2) assess whether deviation-based analyses enhance group comparisons; and (3) examine clinical associations (e.g., ADOS correlations) of subject-specific deviation markers. These statements satisfy both criteria: explicit research questions/hypotheses and the purpose of using normative modeling (heterogeneity characterization and precision psychiatry utility).
cm1_research_objectives.supporting_text: "We combine high-density EEG with normative modeling to quantify this heterogeneity..."; "We develop an end-to-end NM framework... and then systematically quantify the heterogeneity..."; "...explored the potential of NM to provide a framework for generating subject-specific markers... correlated with the patients' clinical assessments (total ADOS scores)."

nm1_selection_criteria_reference_cohort.reason: They build a new normative model. Eligibility and data sources for the reference cohort (healthy controls) are described via the contributing datasets, with inclusion/exclusion criteria cited for HBN and ABC-CT. Image/data quality handling is outlined in the preprocessing pipeline (automated artifact removal, bad channel detection, ICA, Autoreject), and the final sample sizes are reported (HC training n=448; HC test n=112). However, reasons for exclusion at the subject level are not explicitly enumerated, and quality standards are procedural rather than threshold-based across all datasets (some steps omitted for ABCCT; femaleASD preprocessed differently).
nm1_selection_criteria_reference_cohort.supporting_text: "Our cohort consisted of 2234 individuals... healthy controls (n = 448 in the training set, n = 112 in the held-out testing set)... aggregated from five distinct studies..."; "Inclusion criteria required... Exclusion criteria encompassed severe neurological disorders, significant cognitive impairment (IQ<66)..."; "The EEG preprocessing and artifact removal pipeline is executed through a multi-stage, fully automated algorithm... bad EEG channels... ICA... Autoreject... Notably, the Autoreject step was excluded from... ABCCT... femaleASD..."

They also describe balancing across age, sex, and site during cohort construction.
